name: Alberta
short: We found no province-wide heat pump or solar rebate for Alberta homes in 2026. Help comes from city programs: Clean Energy Improvement Program (CEIP) financing in Calgary, Lethbridge and St. Albert (some intakes are closed or on a waitlist), a $50 thermostat rebate in Red Deer, and the free Calgary Home Upgrades Program for income-qualified homes. The federal oil-to-heat-pump program closed on July 31, 2026.

rows.rules: Closed to new pre-qualification as of September 2026.
